name: Batch Document Embeddings
description: Generate vector embeddings for document collections with Azure OpenAI and an Azure Machine Learning managed batch endpoint.
detailedDescription: This lab builds a repeatable batch embedding workflow on Azure Machine Learning. An SDK v2 pipeline validates and normalizes text documents, a managed batch endpoint calls Microsoft Foundry with the compute cluster's managed identity, and the completed job produces a line-delimited JSON embedding artifact for downstream search, clustering, or retrieval workflows.
